summary: Prompt assembly now injects one LLM-facing instruction block plus file contents, and no longer injects QuarterDeck help text into LLM prompts.
title: Simplify injected prompt section format

rationale: The specification matrix distinguishes imported source material from typed specifications. Path-aware prompt metadata prevents arbitrary source filenames from inheriting typed-spec semantics and keeps prompt configuration aligned with actual artifact categories.
summary: Drydock prompt metadata now resolves generic imported sources and questionnaires by path pattern, while target artifacts and typed spec files continue to resolve by exact name or prefix.
title: Model prompt metadata by artifact category

rationale: The orientation page should reflect the current analysis state, not only the first analyzed state. Grouped story counts make the decomposition shape visible without opening ANALYSIS.md.
summary: Captain's Chair now refreshes on every successful analyze run and includes a story breakdown derived from grouped analysis sections.
title: Show analysis shape in Captain's Chair

alternatives.reason_rejected: Relies on model obedience; recurs every run

rationale: The planning LLM consistently emits the compact form; tolerating it salvages plan runs without re-invoking the model and avoids brittle prompt enforcement.
summary: parse_build_plan expands '## ac N: Summary (kind: check)' headers into canonical ac blocks, deriving id/kind/check and inheriting parent from the nearest preceding story/spike/feature.
title: MANIFEST parser accepts compact one-line ac blocks

rationale: The product now standardizes on Commanders Chair terminology and matching artifact filenames to remove mixed naming in the UI, generated outputs, and specifications.
summary: Renamed the QuarterDeck orientation artifact from Captain's Chair to Commanders Chair across runtime paths, UI labels, templates, tests, and documentation.
title: Rename Commanders Chair artifact

rationale: Narrative-only model output was incorrectly marking steps built even when no application files were written. Tying success to filesystem truth and a structured report makes build state reviewable and prevents false-positive progress.

source.command: implement build truthfulness and planning-session review

summary: Drydock build now advances manifest state only when a build step returns a structured success report and produces real file changes in the build directory. Planning Session is read-only and renders the manifest build tree instead of approval controls.
title: Make build success depend on file writes

rationale: The build output needs durable local version history independent of the Drydock workspace, and the operator asked for the repo lifecycle to be automatic and visible during build execution.
summary: Drydock now initializes the build output directory as a git repository on first use and commits resulting build changes after each build run, with explicit CLI status messages.
title: Initialize and commit build output repos

rationale: The navigation model matches the target delivery lifecycle and keeps questionnaires, exclusions, analysis ledgers, planning artifacts, and build controls in their owning phase.
summary: Target QuarterDeck navigation uses Analyze, Plan, and Build sections instead of Core, Blockers, and Action Items. Phase headings show the target name, signal flag, and phase label.
title: Group QuarterDeck navigation by delivery phase

rationale: Target navigation is organized by active delivery phase only: Analyze, Plan, and Build. Archived-item mechanics add a separate category that no longer matches the requested information architecture.
summary: QuarterDeck no longer declares an Archive section, renders archive controls, or exposes archive/unarchive item APIs.
title: Remove QuarterDeck archive navigation

rationale: Existing target-local QuarterDeck state is not regenerated by restarting the reusable web server, so the target console must be migrated to match the current navigation contract.
summary: The existing STIM target console now uses Analysis, Plan, and Build sections. Build remains visible when empty, and Build Compass is treated as a Plan item.
title: Align existing STIM QuarterDeck with phase navigation

rationale: Build agents write software with tool access, so the implementation source must be reproducible and the build workspace must be initialized deterministically.
summary: drydock build now blocks when the Drydock source repository has uncommitted changes, creates the configured build root on first use, and renders build prompts with explicit role sections and implementation specs as the recency anchor.
title: Harden drydock build execution guardrails

rationale: Drydock build stops at implemented when acceptance checks exist; a deterministic review command is required to restore the inspect-approve-continue loop from the phased prototype workflow.
summary: drydock build verify records human acceptance of an implemented build step by marking the step and its child acceptance checks closed/verified, which unblocks dependent build work.
title: Add build verification gate command

rationale: Operators need one-step rebuild control without advancing unrelated work, and build provenance must remain owned by Drydock rather than the LLM agent.
summary: drydock build now supports --step for one selected build step and --force to reset an already built step plus child ACs before rebuilding. The build prompt also forbids agent-side Git commits so Drydock owns the final build-directory commit.
title: Add targeted Drydock build rebuild control

rationale: Build needs a deterministic stale-spec guard before executing additional Manifest work from outdated Blueprint inputs.
summary: Drydock build records applied Blueprint specification hashes in the Manifest and blocks builds when previously applied specifications change or disappear.
title: Track applied Blueprint specification provenance

rationale: Build agents need explicit persistence boundaries and stack requirements to avoid raw storage access and ambiguous module placement.
summary: Drydock planning now treats DATABASE.md as an interface-first persistence contract with required access patterns, persistence interfaces, architecture module ownership, and persistence stack guidance.
title: Tighten persistence encapsulation contracts

rationale: Ensures every built target project carries current business rules and traceable build provenance, enabling compliant agent context without manual injection.
summary: drydock rigging update injects BUSINESS_RULES_compact.md into built target AGENTS.md via DRYDOCK_RIGGING_START/END markers and stamps provenance fields into METADATA.md. drydock rigging verify checks the injected block by content hash and flags missing required fields.
title: Implement rigging update and rigging verify

rationale: Target documentation is a public Drydock capability and no longer runs against the Drydock repository documentation builder.
summary: Implemented drydock document generate, assemble, and full Target documentation pipeline for Target DOC Markdown and docs/index.html output.
title: Implement Target documentation pipeline

rationale: Generated artifacts belong in DRYDOCK_BUILD_DIRECTORY, while the Target workspace keeps durable configuration and Blueprint inputs.
summary: Target documentation configuration remains in the Target workspace root while generated DOC Markdown, CSS, and HTML are build artifacts under the configured Target build docs directory.
title: Correct Target documentation artifact locations

rationale: Whitepaper-style publishing is separate from Target documentation and requires deterministic rendering without LLM execution.
summary: Drydock now exposes drydock publish to render frontmatter Markdown into publishable HTML, with optional PDF rendering through a local browser renderer.
title: Add deterministic Markdown publishing

rationale: The Analysis tab is the primary source of analyzed counts; the Chair must render the same feature/story/questionnaire/blocker shape and avoid counting analysis notes as stories.
summary: Analyze now directs feature-grouped Story List output and the Commanders Chair reports Features, Stories, Questionnaires, and Blockers instead of separate Screens.
title: Align analyze outputs on features and questionnaires

rationale: QuarterDeck renders saved answer fields, and plan creation consumes answered questionnaire fields; generated metadata proposals must not appear as empty boxes, while stack choices must remain user-selected.
summary: Analyze now persists identity questionnaire proposals as answer values and normalizes stack questionnaires as alphabetized multi-select checkbox grids with empty answers.
title: Normalize analyze discovery questionnaire answers

rationale: Failed or partial plan output must not leave an invalid MANIFEST.md or stale QuarterDeck projection in the target workspace.
summary: drydock plan now requires one strict LLM artifact response mode and validates the complete response before writing Blueprint, Manifest, or QuarterDeck artifacts.
title: Harden plan artifact output contract

rationale: LLM-assisted commands need clean failure notifications and must not leave partial or invented output artifacts when model output violates the command contract.
summary: Drydock now shares strict delimited artifact parsing across analyze, document generation, and survey import, rejecting malformed/noisy/partial model output before generated artifacts are written.
title: Harden LLM artifact guard rails

rationale: Files that have been applied form the load-bearing graph database. Replanning when new source files arrive must not destroy evidence of what was built or force re-execution of completed work.
summary: drydock plan create now merges prior MANIFEST.md state on replan instead of clean-regenerating. applied_specs is restored verbatim, closed/verified block states are carried forward for clean files, dirty files reset to pending, and applied Blueprint files are protected from LLM overwrite.
title: Replan idempotency: state-preserving MANIFEST.md merge

evidence: tests/test_refit.py (33 tests pass), tests/test_cli.py::TestRefit (3 tests pass)
rationale: Change tickets dropped into blueprint/changes/ by the Commander or an external ticketing system need to be conformed to the Drydock build process before drydock build can execute them. Refit is the targeted, safe complement to plan create.
summary: drydock refit <Target> is implemented. title: Implement drydock refit command

rationale: Architecture and database files need builder-facing compaction algorithms that preserve structural and persistence constraints, while other technical files still use contract-surface compaction.
summary: Drydock rigging compact now selects dedicated contracts, architecture, and database compaction prompts by exact source filename instead of using one generic compaction prompt.
title: Make rigging compaction role-based

alternatives.reason_rejected: Left architecture and database compact injection inconsistent and prompt-heavy.

rationale: Architecture and database specifications are repeatedly injected into non-screen implementation work, so feature-step prompts need stable low-token structural and persistence context without relying on manual Manifest context authoring or generic first-use compact substitution.
summary: Drydock now auto-generates and refreshes ARCHITECTURE and DATABASE compact derivatives during planning and before builds, and FEATURE build steps deterministically receive the compact derivatives as prompt context while SCREEN steps do not.
title: Auto-inject compact architecture and database context for feature steps

rationale: Claude runs intermittently emit structurally complete artifacts with wrapper defects; narrow recovery avoids failed runs without accepting ordinary prose preambles.
summary: Recovered strict artifact parsing from missing first delimiters, missing final delimiters, and pure Write-call transcripts across plan, analyze, document generation, and survey import.
title: Harden artifact parsing recovery

rationale: Claude occasionally injects progress narration such as 'Continuing with ...' between valid artifacts; rejecting those lines causes expensive false failures even though the artifact set is structurally complete.
summary: Artifact parsing now ignores narrow transition/status lines that appear between otherwise valid artifact blocks or simulated Write-call artifacts after emission has started.
title: Ignore artifact transition chatter

rationale: Observed plan runs where Claude's final result field was truncated mid-artifact while the streamed deltas contained the complete response; using the final result as authoritative caused false artifact-contract failures across commands.
summary: Claude execution now reconstructs response text from streamed text events and uses the final result blob only as a fallback when the stream is empty.
title: Trust Claude stream text over final result

rationale: Imported Prototyper-derived Blueprints can already be structurally usable; forcing a one-shot full Blueprint rewrite creates unnecessary prompt/output volume and fragility when the real need is executable planning and light conformance repair.
summary: drydock plan now detects existing typed Blueprint specs, normalizes them locally, and switches to a reuse-oriented prompt that emits MANIFEST.md plus only truly missing spec files instead of rewriting the entire Blueprint.
title: Add manifest-first reuse mode to plan

alternatives.reason_rejected: Rejected because running the next build command already signals Commander approval and made verification a high-friction default path.

rationale: Automatic executable assertions preserve a valid acceptance gate without requiring a separate manual verification command for every completed story.
summary: Drydock build acceptance now distinguishes Blueprint-owned programmatic Python assertions from user acceptance review signals; build runs programmatic checks automatically after each story and no longer relies on whole-plan approval or ordinary build verify flow.
title: Move build acceptance into Blueprint assertions

rationale: Prompt size alone does not reveal which planning path executed; explicit reporting makes mode selection visible during failure analysis and user validation.
summary: drydock plan now prints the selected planning mode, prompt name, and Blueprint inventory counts before LLM execution so operators can distinguish full-rewrite from manifest-first reuse runs.
title: Report plan execution mode explicitly

rationale: Planner mode reporting existed in the application module but was invisible to operators because the CLI entrypoint was not forwarding the text callback.
summary: The drydock plan CLI now passes on_text=print into planning_session.create_plan so planning-mode reports and live progress reach the terminal.
title: Forward plan progress text through CLI

rationale: Prototyper-derived imports already carry typed spec documents, but previous reuse detection ignored them because they lived under sources/; adoption converts that imported specification into a real Blueprint basis for manifest-first planning.
summary: When blueprint/ has no typed spec files but blueprint/sources contains typed spec filenames, drydock plan now copies those files into blueprint/, reports the adoption, and evaluates reuse mode against the adopted specs.
title: Adopt typed source specs into blueprint before planning

rationale: import --format speckit only stages raw Spec Kit files under blueprint/sources/ without translation; the actual constitution/spec/plan/research-to-Blueprint mapping documented in the Spec Kit Import Contract had no implementation. Routing detection through plan create (alongside the existing reuse and full-rewrite modes) reuses the existing single-LLM-call planning architecture instead of adding a separate translation pass.
summary: drydock plan create now detects a Spec Kit source tree (blueprint/sources/.specify/) left by 'import --format speckit' and switches to a dedicated plan_create_speckit prompt implementing the Spec Kit Import Contract mapping table, emitting a CONVERSION_REPORT.md review-evidence block alongside the usual Blueprint specs and MANIFEST.md.
title: Add Spec Kit translation mode to plan create

rationale: Ed rejected gating detection on a hidden dot-directory as fragile and undesirable to have living inside blueprint/sources/ at all. The .specify/ requirement is retained only as source-side validation (discover_speckit still requires it on the original Spec Kit project being imported).

source.command: drydock import --format speckit / drydock plan create

summary: import --format speckit no longer nests a hidden .specify/ directory under blueprint/sources/; its children are copied directly under sources/ (e.g. sources/memory/constitution.md). plan create's speckit-translate mode now detects Spec Kit sources via sources/memory/constitution.md or sources/specs/*/spec.md instead of the .specify/ directory.
title: Flatten .specify/ on Spec Kit import; detect via memory/constitution.md

alternatives.option: Essay-style notes with concept titles and transferable principles
alternatives.reason_rejected: Abstracted the project away entirely; output never named Drydock and read as interchangeable AI-generated prose

rationale: Essay-style posts with coined headlines and abstract 'transferable principles' hid the actual engineering work and read as generic AI prose. A log that names the real commands, dates, and recorded rationale demonstrates the work directly.
summary: BRANDING_POSTS.md V2 redefines Ed's published posts as Drydock development logs: fixed-format titles, a lead paragraph, then dated Milestones and Changes bullets drawn verbatim from Ship's Log events. The voice is the canonical specification voice — present-tense, declarative, third-person — naming Drydock, its command surface, and its components. Posts are dated by the work window, carry no tags or subtitles, and render in the Slate brand with the Drydock logo.
title: Published dev posts are development logs in specification voice

alternatives.reason_rejected: Produces partial-week posts and requires scheduling; a full-week gate makes any-day invocation idempotent
Windows drift with event timing and can overlap or gap, breaking continuous bottom-up reading

rationale: Ed wants the development log publishable on demand without a daily job: running the command any day is safe because only fully elapsed aligned weeks generate posts, and alignment keeps consecutive posts contiguous for bottom-up reading. Week windows anchored to the first unseen event were rejected because they drift and can overlap or gap between runs.
summary: drydock shipslog generates development-log posts from unpublished Ship's Log events, one post per aligned Thursday-to-Wednesday week that has fully elapsed. The week in progress is never published and empty weeks are skipped, so the posts index reads as a continuous chronological record. The posts package resolves from --dir, then the new shipslog_dir configuration key, then ./ShipsLog. The specification's exclusion of Ship's Log operations from the public CLI now applies to event recording only.
title: Add public drydock shipslog command with full-week publication cadence

alternatives.reason_rejected: Rejected: fixes the executor, not the contract; less Drydock-idiomatic and doesn't make the AC self-contained

rationale: A Marina2 boto3 grep gate failed as a false positive by scanning its own .venv (which contains boto3) and moto test fixtures. Root cause was an underspecified AC, not a builder skill gap; fixing it at analysis time makes the contract precise and reproducible instead of relying on executor competence.
summary: analyze.md now requires any static/filesystem scan gate (import boundary, grep/AST gate) to state its scan root, exclusions (.venv, site-packages, vendored/generated code), and permitted test-double exceptions. build.md gains a backstop to honor that scope and never widen it.
title: Scan-gate acceptance criteria must carry their own scope

summary: QuarterDeck Build Compass: removed per-story reorder (kept change-group + group reorder), relabelled group rollup 'Combined Story Points', made Missing/over-NNK bordered tags, and made completed steps/groups loud with a green check badge and left-rail. Fixed drydock build console output shredding words across lines by streaming LLM deltas verbatim.
title: Build Compass visualization pass and build console streaming fix
